name: Lloyd N. Bell
tagline: Top rated Medical Malpractice attorney in Atlanta, Georgia
education: Mercer University Walter F. George School of Law
about: With more than 30 years of legal experience, Lloyd Bell has recovered hundreds of millions of dollars for medical malpractice and catastrophic injury victims. A US Army JAG Corps veteran, Lloyd founded his own law firm in 1999 and is consistently recognized as one of the nation’s top trial attorneys. In 2022, Lloyd and his team achieved a $75 million verdict , the largest medical malpractice verdict in Georgia’s history. He also secured a record-breaking $26 million verdict in 2017 against a Columbus hospital and a $15 million verdict against the largest healthcare provider in Georgia.

Lloyd is the only Georgia attorney in the Inner Circle of Advocates , a prestigious invitation-only group of the nation’s leading trial lawyers. Lloyd is also a member of the AAJ Leaders Forum , a board member of the American Board of Trial Advocates Georgia Chapter, and is board certified by the American Board of Professional Liability Attorneys.
